name: caller-principal-node-session-stop-admits-an-absent-principal
description: KTD12 -- the Node side of fixture 03, with the identical setup and request: a client claims session A (Node answers 404 -- it issues no principals) and then stops A without a principal. Node admits the stop that Python refuses. This is the asymmetry itself -- a stop naming a session a client tried to claim -- not the unbound-session admission both runtimes share (fixture 15). Goes red the day Node starts refusing, or grows the claim.
